verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a hardware system-on-chip. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can call their tools is a software agent or client capability, so this is a category error for a chip. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself acting as an MCP client; running local LLMs or ML frameworks on the chip is a host-platform capability, not MCP tool use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
